passages.note: Enrolled act cuts the individual income tax rate but in the same bill also repeals the utility receipts tax, sets a special mini-mill property valuation, and amends Medicaid managed-care reporting.
Bill details page names Mishler as a Senate sponsor of the same multi-subject 'various tax matters' bill.
passages.actor_quote: Sponsored by: Sen. Ryan Mishler, Sen. Travis Holdman, Sen. Lonnie Randolph

rows.reasoning: All three passages are on one instrument, HB 1002 (2022), a multi-subject bill ('Various tax matters') that cuts the individual income tax rate while also repealing the utility receipts tax, creating a special property-tax valuation for mini-mill equipment, and amending unrelated partnership-audit and Medicaid managed-care provisions. Under V4.1 a vote or sponsorship of a multi-subject bill proves a chair only if the person's own words tie the act to the specific rung clause, and no such statement from Mishler is in these sources.
